import sys

sum_arr = [0] * 105
pw = [0] * 105
ok = False

def process(cur, target, pos):
    global ok
    if cur == target:
        ok = True
        return
    remaining = sum_arr[pos + 1]
    next_val = pw[pos]
    if cur - remaining > target:
        return
    if cur + remaining < target:
        return
    if cur + sum_arr[pos] < target:
        process(cur + next_val, target, pos - 1)
    elif cur - sum_arr[pos] > target:
        process(cur - next_val, target, pos - 1)
    else:
        process(cur, target, pos - 1)

def main():
    global ok
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])

    p = 1
    mx = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 100:
        sum_arr[i + 1] = p + sum_arr[i]
        pw[i] = p
        p *= w
        if p > 1 << 40:
            mx = i
            break
        i += 1

    process(0, m, mx)
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
